name: What permits are required to build an aging-in-place tiny home in San Marcos?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required to build an aging-in-place tiny home in San Marcos?

acceptedAnswer.text: In San Marcos, building an aging-in-place tiny home, especially if it's considered an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), typically requires several permits. These commonly include a building permit, electrical permit, plumbing permit, and mechanical permit. Depending on site-specific conditions, you might also need permits for grading, septic systems, or specific utility connections. Navigating these requirements can be complex, but Zen Tiny Homes assists clients with the entire permitting process to ensure all local regulations and zoning ordinances are met before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building in San Marcos generally requires building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits, especially for ADUs. Zen Tiny Homes assists with the permitting process.
